scope: Unchanged released decoders at each era's decoder version (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9) from Shelley to Conway: DecCBOR Addr (fromCborAddr) and DecCBOR AccountAddress (fromCborAccountAddress) of the CBOR byte string of an address or a reward account alone, every header (sixteen types, sixteen low nibbles) over the payload of its type; and decodeFullAnnotator of a transaction body holding an address or a reward account of network 1 and 2 in each place a body reads one (an enterprise, a base and a pointer output, a withdrawal, a pool registration's reward account, from Babbage a collateral return, in Conway a proposal's return account and a treasury withdrawal); no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

address.note: fromCborBothAddr by decoder version (459-477); headerByron, isByronAddress, headerNonShelleyBits = 0b10001110, headerNetworkId (548-561); decodeAddrStateLenientT refuses a Shelley header with a bit of headerNonShelleyBits set (655-666); fromCborAccountAddress, headerIsAccountAddress = header .&. 0b11101110 == 0b11100000, decodeAccountAddressT (913-955)
